summary: Identification of concrete readiness gaps, missing assets, and ordered prerequisite sequence for Gate05 native validation.

gaps.name: RUNTIME_COPY_ASSET_INCOMPLETENESS
gaps.observed_state: Only 7 files present (33,030,151 bytes). Missing RimWorldWin64_Data, Managed libraries, Mono runtime, Data\Core XML defs, About.xml, ModsConfig.xml.
gaps.technical_consequence: RimWorldWin64.exe standalone Unity player cannot initialize; halts or hangs in batchmode, triggering parent process timeout kill.
gaps.resolution_requirement: Master must authorize complete project-isolated runtime staging from user's licensed installation into scratch\EngineGate05NativeSlice\RuntimeCopy before native run.

gaps.name: INSTALLED_DLL_IDENTITY_INCIDENT_OPEN
gaps.observed_state: Observed SHA256 BB3B52F39F7B53B70BC9FB4CE039E7455D08B24B17B8DABB8295E0FF4584DD61 differs from archive baseline 2D64FF9C56E4F5CB5E3395D10FCFDB1E56B6767F00CC351FBA93F9F132254A4C.
gaps.technical_consequence: Actor and cause remain UNKNOWN. Developer A is strictly prohibited from modifying, restoring, or normalizing Steam baseline.
gaps.resolution_requirement: All future native runs must execute exclusively within isolated project RuntimeCopy directories, completely bypassing the Steam installation directory.

gaps.name: NATIVE_CURRENT_GAME_DEPENDENCY_IN_CENSUS
gaps.observed_state: Census generation requires Current.Game != null, ProgramState == Playing, and initialized Map and DefDatabase.
gaps.technical_consequence: Standalone managed runners cannot execute live census generation without booting the full RimWorld engine.
gaps.resolution_requirement: Live census validation must execute inside the child RimWorld process after loading the staged save into the engine.

gaps.name: DYNAMIC_PATCH_AND_SETTINGS_EVALUATION_SEPARATE
gaps.observed_state: Settings disposition fixed to USER_MOD_SETTINGS_EXCLUDED and patch disposition fixed to COUNT_OBSERVED_RAW_AST_EXCLUDED.
gaps.technical_consequence: Dynamic XML patch AST execution and user settings evaluation remain qualified boundaries under ADR-006B-v5.
gaps.resolution_requirement: Recognized as qualified admission boundary; future expansion requires separate ADR and work package.

gaps.name: MD131_ATOMIC_PROMOTION_PRIMITIVES_DEFERRED
gaps.observed_state: Same-volume atomic file replacement primitives and existing-final replacement fail-closed logic belong to MD131.
gaps.technical_consequence: This slice terminates upon receipt issuance and transition to STAGED_VALIDATED. Final save promotion is not executed.
gaps.resolution_requirement: Deferred to separate dedicated MD131 slice.

gaps.name: FOUNDATION_HOLD_AND_DOMAIN_AUTHORITY
gaps.observed_state: Engine002/006, Pipeline007, current schema, and G-Q1 remain OPEN. Foundation remains HOLD.
gaps.technical_consequence: Developer A cannot self-declare gate closure, candidate release, or E2 verification. Dedicated Server is final Domain Authority.
gaps.resolution_requirement: Developer A records PREPARATION_COMPLETE_NATIVE_UNTESTED. Master conducts review and coordinates independent QA.
